body.title: The useful change
body.content: **Consolidating the overnight schedule** increased observations while reducing energy per observation. Keep the daytime schedule steady until the next review.

## What the numbers leave out

The improvement is **indicative**. Station West had a shorter maintenance window, so the schedule change does not explain the entire gain. The next review should compare matched operating hours.

> A useful dashboard preserves the explanation alongside the chart.

### Before the next review

1. Compare stations during matching operating hours.
2. Keep the overnight schedule unchanged.
3. Review energy use alongside observation quality.

The decision log uses `energy / accepted observations`, rather than raw throughput. Read more about [observatory planning](https://example.com/observatory).
